bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹突破 $1,300，仍低于 10 日均线

read.en: Sandisk rose 3.9% on Oct 27 to $1,304.84, trading between $1,259.00 and $1,315.98. It is above the falling 5-day ($1,287.5) and rising 200-day ($1,245.6) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($1,327.2), 30-day ($1,570.3) and 100-day ($1,616.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,374.93), and RSI is 37.

The close cleared $1,276–1,287.8 and $1,300 (Oct 15 low, Oct 26 high, Oct 23 high), now support. Resistance is $1,316 (Oct 27 high), then $1,325–1,327 (Jul 17 low, 10-day) and $1,375 (SAR). Support is $1,287.5–1,300 (5-day, Oct 23 high), then $1,276 (Oct 15 low) and $1,244.6–1,245.6 (Oct 22 low, 200-day). A close above $1,327 would target $1,375; below $1,287, $1,245.

s.en: Oct 23 high $1,300, cleared; 5-day average $1,287.5; Oct 26 high $1,287.8
